# Warlock AI Google

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-google`

> Google Gemini adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-google](@warlock.js/ai-google/skills/SKILL.md): Google Gemini and Imagen adapter for Warlock AI: `GoogleSDK`, `GeminiImageModel`, `GoogleImageModel`, `GoogleCallOptions` and `GOOGLE_MODEL_PRICING`. Use for "connect Gemini", thinking, streaming, tools, embeddings, images or grounded search through `model()`, `embedder()` and `image()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for orchestration; @warlock.js/ai-live for video and realtime sessions.
